task:
FIX ONE REVIEW FINDING on PR #787 (Review Lab Phase 2 step 1). Target branch codex/run-37827870449-1, expected head 25c437b31695878dd5859d8d16e7db76295a812c; fail closed if it moved.

FINDING (confirmed by the reviewer and by Claude): scripts/dev/build_review_lab_v3_fixture.py moves the three systems to new coordinates but keeps the TEMPLATE systems' grid_x, grid_y, grid_z and macro_grid_key. The V3 map viewport query prefilters on s.grid_x/y/z BETWEEN floor(lo/10) AND floor(hi/10) before checking x_ly/y_ly/z_ly (apps/api/src/routers/map.py:664-676), so once this fixture is selected no viewport around the new locations would return them. Current wrong values: Review Wiring (100,100,100) has grid (6,-12,2); Review Aggregate (500,100,100) has (-143,95,-498); Review Fallback (3000,100,100) has (23,3,18).

FIX: in _rewrite_system, recompute grid_x/grid_y/grid_z and macro_grid_key from the NEW coordinates using the SAME contract the real importer uses: apps/importer/src/v3_spansh/adapter.py:426 computes gx,gy,gz = floor(value / GRID_EDGE_LY) with GRID_EDGE_LY = 10.0, and macro_grid_key(gx, gy, gz) from apps/importer/src/v3_spansh/contracts.py:127. Import GRID_EDGE_LY and macro_grid_key from that contracts module (add apps/importer/src to sys.path the same way the script already adds apps/api/src) rather than copying the hash, so the fixture cannot drift from the importer. Expected grid results: Wiring (10,10,10), Aggregate (50,10,10), Fallback (300,10,10). Correct the misleading comment that says grid_* and macro_grid_key are not read. Leave galaxy_region_id untouched (it is null in the template for all three, which is not coordinate-stale). Do NOT change the Cypress builder or Cypress fixture even though it has the same latent pattern; that is out of scope.

Then REGENERATE the four committed artifacts with the builder (canonical.json and manifest.json will change; source-metadata.json and the zip should not) and add ONE test to tests/test_review_lab_v3.py asserting, for each of the three systems in the committed canonical.json, that grid_x/y/z == floor(coord / GRID_EDGE_LY) and macro_grid_key == macro_grid_key(grid_x, grid_y, grid_z), imported from the importer contracts module. Do not edit or remove existing tests.

FILES YOU MAY TOUCH: scripts/dev/build_review_lab_v3_fixture.py, tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources/canonical.json, tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources/manifest.json, tests/test_review_lab_v3.py (and source-metadata.json / spansh-system-dumps.zip ONLY if regeneration genuinely changes them, which it should not). Nothing else.

VALIDATE and report commands and results: python -m py_compile on the script; ruff check on the script and the test file; python -m pytest tests/test_review_lab_v3.py -q (all must pass, including the existing byte-reproducibility test against the regenerated artifacts); git diff --name-only against the expected head showing only allowed paths.
